bundle.longDescription: ZArchiveForge is a fast, lightweight, 100% offline desktop app for creating password-protected archives (ZIP & 7z with AES-256, plus RAR via an external binary) and recovering access to encrypted archives using dictionary, mask, and brute-force attacks — with live metrics and pause/resume.
